headline: Kazakhstan reduced the number of inspections of Kyrgyzstani transport at the border
summary: Kazakhstan has significantly reduced checks of Kyrgyz vehicles at the common border. About 10 percent of such transport was inspected in 2022, according to the report.
why: Border inspection rules affect the time and cost of road freight between Central Asian neighbours. Easing these checks can lower trade friction for Kyrgyz exporters and hauliers.
original_headline: Казахстан сократил количество досмотров кыргызстанского транспорта на границе
